'''Crashion''' is small blind bloodhound-like [[Litho-Titan]].

== History ==
Despite being blind, Crashion is dangerous hunter. Crashion titans do not have to see what they are hunting for but rely on their speed, sense of smell and sheer power.

== Abilities ==
Crashion relies on its sharp senses to track down their prey, not requiring the ability to see. Its sharp claws and teeth are strong enough to tear through fences and walls.
